tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards in the workspace; app background in the companion app.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, the sidebar, the header, bottom nav. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and sheets — anything that floats above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, segmented-control tracks, read-only fields, progress tracks.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and nav-item hover on surface. Never used as a resting fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card outlines, table row dividers, header and sidebar edges. Decorative only — never the sole outline of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Section dividers that must read clearly, the outline of a dashed empty-state box.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface and bg in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and bg.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, table meta, field hints, inactive nav labels. On surface, raised, sunken and bg.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholders, column headers. On surface, sunken and bg (4.5:1+). Not for anything a user must read to act.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast rules).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an ink-coloured fill such as a tooltip.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Capabble blue from the logo — the school-themeable brand hue. Icons, selected indicators, chart series 1, the active tab underline. Not for small text on white (4.2:1); use accent-strong for text.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, links and selected text on surface or bg. School-themeable: generated so on-accent passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-strong-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent-strong fills and links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-strong and accent-strong-hover fills. Never hard-code white.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav row, selected filter chip, today's cell in a calendar, the current period in a timetable.

tokens.name: accent-soft-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-soft.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1+ on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Capabble's cyan from the logo highlight. Charts and empty-state illustration only; never text, never a status. Not school-themed.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on success-soft, surface and bg. Meaning: paid, present, active, published, completed, approved.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and banner background for success.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a success banner or callout.

tokens.name: success-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, progress fills and chart marks meaning success. Never a text background.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on warning-soft, surface and bg. Meaning: pending, partial, on leave, due soon, on hold, needs review.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and banner background for warning.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a warning banner or callout.

tokens.name: warning-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, progress fills and chart marks meaning warning. Never a text background.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger text and icons on danger-soft, surface and bg. Meaning: overdue, absent, rejected, cancelled, failed, error.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and banner background for danger.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a danger banner or callout.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, progress fills and chart marks meaning danger. Never a text background.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Info text and icons on info-soft, surface and bg. Meaning: due, scheduled, in progress, upcoming, new.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and banner background for info.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a info banner or callout.

tokens.name: info-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, progress fills and chart marks meaning info. Never a text background.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Neutral text and icons on neutral-soft, surface and bg. Meaning: draft, archived, holiday, inactive, not started.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and banner background for neutral.

tokens.name: neutral-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a neutral banner or callout.

tokens.name: neutral-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, progress fills and chart marks meaning neutral. Never a text background.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of a destructive button (delete, void, reject).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-strong.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1 — the default series. Fixed categorical palette; pair with labels, never colour alone.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2. Fixed categorical palette; pair with labels, never colour alone.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3. Fixed categorical palette; pair with labels, never colour alone.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4. Fixed categorical palette; pair with labels, never colour alone.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series 5. Fixed categorical palette; pair with labels, never colour alone.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Series 6. Fixed categorical palette; pair with labels, never colour alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Mobile: the dimmed layer behind a bottom sheet, action sheet or dialog. Tapping it dismisses.

tokens.name: material-chrome
tokens.usage: Mobile: translucent ground of the navigation bar, tab bar and sticky action bar, always with a 20px background blur. Text on it is ink / ink-muted (the blur keeps it above 4.5:1). Chrome only, never cards.

tokens.name: fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Mobile: overlay on a row, tile or card while the finger is down (with a 0.97 scale on cards and tiles). Never a resting fill.

tokens.name: fill-control
tokens.usage: Mobile: the resting fill of search fields, segmented-control and stepper tracks, gray buttons and sheet close buttons. Translucent so it reads on bg, surface and sheets alike (surface-sunken goes darker than bg in dark mode, which looks like a hole on phones).

tokens.name: tile-1
tokens.usage: Mobile: ground of a shortcut tile or list-row icon tile (blue), from chart-1's hue. Fixed per module, never re-themed; ink passes 12:1+ on it. Decorative identity, never a status.

tokens.name: tile-1-ink
tokens.usage: Mobile: the Lucide glyph on tile-1 (5:1+ light, 7.8:1+ dark).

tokens.name: tile-2
tokens.usage: Mobile: ground of a shortcut tile or list-row icon tile (cyan), from chart-2's hue. Fixed per module, never re-themed; ink passes 12:1+ on it. Decorative identity, never a status.

tokens.name: tile-2-ink
tokens.usage: Mobile: the Lucide glyph on tile-2 (5:1+ light, 7.8:1+ dark).

tokens.name: tile-3
tokens.usage: Mobile: ground of a shortcut tile or list-row icon tile (amber), from chart-3's hue. Fixed per module, never re-themed; ink passes 12:1+ on it. Decorative identity, never a status.

tokens.name: tile-3-ink
tokens.usage: Mobile: the Lucide glyph on tile-3 (5:1+ light, 7.8:1+ dark).

tokens.name: tile-4
tokens.usage: Mobile: ground of a shortcut tile or list-row icon tile (violet), from chart-4's hue. Fixed per module, never re-themed; ink passes 12:1+ on it. Decorative identity, never a status.

tokens.name: tile-4-ink
tokens.usage: Mobile: the Lucide glyph on tile-4 (5:1+ light, 7.8:1+ dark).

tokens.name: tile-5
tokens.usage: Mobile: ground of a shortcut tile or list-row icon tile (green), from chart-5's hue. Fixed per module, never re-themed; ink passes 12:1+ on it. Decorative identity, never a status.

tokens.name: tile-5-ink
tokens.usage: Mobile: the Lucide glyph on tile-5 (5:1+ light, 7.8:1+ dark).

tokens.name: tile-6
tokens.usage: Mobile: ground of a shortcut tile or list-row icon tile (rose), from chart-6's hue. Fixed per module, never re-themed; ink passes 12:1+ on it. Decorative identity, never a status.

tokens.name: tile-6-ink
tokens.usage: Mobile: the Lucide glyph on tile-6 (5:1+ light, 7.8:1+ dark).

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", sans-serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, in PageHeader. 20px/28px on mobile.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Group headings inside a page; companion-app screen titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Collected from 412 of 540 students this term.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Default text in the companion app (parents, students) and on mobile.
styles.sample: Aarav's fees for Term 2 are due on 15 Oct.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Table cells, dense lists, secondary lines in cards.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text (size sm, md), nav items, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest text allowed: badges, table column headers, timestamps. Nothing below 12px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The main number in a StatCard. Always tabular numerals.

styles.name: m-hero
styles.usage: Mobile: the one big fact on a screen — an amount due, an ETA, a percentage — in a Hero. One per screen, tabular figures.

styles.name: m-large-title
styles.usage: Mobile: the iOS large title at the top of a tab's root screen; collapses into m-nav-title on scroll.

styles.name: m-nav-title
styles.usage: Mobile: the centred title in the 44px navigation bar of pushed screens and collapsed large titles.

styles.name: m-section
styles.usage: Mobile: headings above a rail, shortcut grid or list group on a scrolling screen.

styles.name: m-headline
styles.usage: Mobile: the primary line of a list row or rail card, button labels at control-lg.

styles.name: m-subhead
styles.usage: Mobile: the secondary line of a row or card, list-group footers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell vertical padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; gap inside a card's header.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; page gutter on mobile; default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top/bottom breathing room on empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, nav items, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, segmented controls, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, sheets, mobile list groups.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots, progress bars, pills.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Mobile: cards, list groups, rail cards, the action bar, the hero.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Mobile: top corners of bottom sheets and action sheets.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Mobile: shortcut tiles (56px) and 32px list-row icon tiles use 8px — squircle-like corners.

shadow.note: Borders separate; shadows only lift things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Cards (with a border), buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-card-m
tokens.usage: Mobile: cards, list groups and rail cards on bg — replaces the web's border + shadow-xs. In dark it becomes a faint ring.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Mobile: the top edge of the tab bar and the sticky action bar.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Mobile: the floating action bar (pay, mark attendance) when it hovers above content and the tab bar.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of controls and the app shell.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons and inputs in toolbars and table rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and selects in the workspace.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs in the companion app and on touch; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Workspace table row height (13px text).

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Companion-app list rows and mobile table cards' minimum height.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Top bar in the workspace and companion app.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded workspace sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icon-only workspace sidebar.

tokens.name: bottom-nav-height
tokens.usage: Companion-app bottom tab bar (plus the device safe area).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of workspace page content.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Mobile: the minimum hit area for anything tappable (Apple HIG 44pt). Small glyphs get hit slop to reach it.

tokens.name: nav-bar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile: the iOS navigation bar under the status bar (back, title, actions).

tokens.name: large-title-height
tokens.usage: Mobile: the band holding the large title below the nav bar on a tab's root screen.

tokens.name: tab-bar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile: the native tab bar, plus the home-indicator safe area (34px on Face ID iPhones).

tokens.name: row-m
tokens.usage: Mobile: one-line rows in a list group with a 32px icon tile; two-line rows grow to 64px.

tokens.name: tile-size
tokens.usage: Mobile: the tinted square in a ShortcutGrid cell; the cell itself is 1/4 of the width.

tokens.name: action-bar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile: the floating action bar's height, 12px above the tab bar or the home indicator.
